name: Mimasaka Mikoto
source: Full of energy and always lively. Was very close to her grandpa, but her parents rarely let her see him, making her yearn for him even more. Upon learning about his frail health, she decided to become a caregiver and got certified. Without telling her parents, she headed to her grandpa’s place.
